auth: Authorization: Bearer $MAKEFUN_SHOP_TOKEN; missing or wrong token answers 401 JSON; /api/v3/ root and /api/v3/meta are unauthenticated

git.acks: ACK every held have; ready + packfile when a held have is an ancestor of a want; NAK + flush when none is held; ACKs + flush without a packfile when none is an ancestor
git.advertisements: v2 (version 2, ls-refs=unborn, fetch=shallow wait-for-done filter, object-format=sha1) and v0 (# service=..., capabilities on first line, capabilities^{} for an empty repo, ^{} peel lines, trailing flush)
git.fetch: v2 sections acknowledgments / shallow-info / packfile split by delim and closed by flush; v0 shallow lines, ACK/NAK, sideband pack, flush; shallow-info lines carry no trailing newline
git.objects: closure(wants, depth-limited) minus closure(haves, not past declared shallow boundaries); boundary commits included with tree/blobs
git.receivePack: per-ref fast-forward; report-status in outer sideband band 1; unpack ok + ok/ng per ref; non-fast-forward refused with exactly that reason; malformed upload-pack POST answers 400

graphql.endpoint: POST /api/graphql; no auth answers exactly 401; a body array answers an array in order
graphql.errors: unknown field is HTTP 200 with errors naming the field; unknown repository is data.repository = null with no errors
graphql.pagination: issues(first, after) with pageInfo {hasNextPage, endCursor}; cursor is base64url of issue:<seq>
graphql.relayIds: base64url of Kind:owner/repo/...; opaque, stable, never the plain databaseId or number
graphql.states: Issue OPEN/CLOSED; PullRequest OPEN/CLOSED/MERGED; mergeable MERGEABLE/CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN

lifecycle.done: poll GET $MAKEFUN_ENV_URL/done until {"done": true}, then exit 0

mcp.endpoint: POST /mcp; DELETE accepted; no auth answers 401; malformed body answers HTTP 400 with JSON-RPC -32700
mcp.legacy: initialize echoes the negotiated protocolVersion; notifications/initialized accepted
mcp.modern: server/discover answers {supportedVersions, capabilities: {tools: {}}, serverInfo} with serverInfo also in _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo']; no handshake, no session id
mcp.toolCall: {content: [{type: text, text: JSON}], structuredContent: same, isError: false}; unknown tool is JSON-RPC -32602; missing required arguments are isError: true

performance.fetchPackCache: 16 entries keyed by (repo, wants, haves, shallow, depth, object count)

rest.errors: JSON {message}; 404 unknown, 422 duplicate/unknown label/bad ref, 409 stale sha, 405 closed or conflicted merge
rest.pagination: per_page (default 30, max 100) and page; Link header with absolute same-origin next/last

summary: A deterministic in-memory GitHub-core clone serving REST, GraphQL, MCP and git smart HTTP over one shared store.
